heading: Retained figure
displayHelp: This view shows one series and up to 32 observations. Axes keep the complete figure range. Long labels are abbreviated, annotations are omitted, and up to 128 custom ticks are shown. Complete downloads retain all content.
heatmapHelp: This view shows one series and up to 32 categories, using the final retained value for each cell. Complete downloads retain all categories and series.
changed: The figure changed. Close and reopen it before continuing.
invalidRange: Enter a position within the retained range.
hidden: This series is hidden in the retained presentation. Its observations remain readable.
invalidText: The retained text response is invalid.
invalidPreview: The figure preview response does not match the requested language.
